scenes.caption: Last Friday.
scenes.say: Last Friday, my class went to Lahore Zoo.

scenes.caption: First.
scenes.say: First, we got on the bus. I sat next to my friend.

scenes.caption: Then.
scenes.say: Then we saw the giraffes. They ate leaves from the trees.

scenes.caption: Next.
scenes.say: Next, we heard a lion roar. I felt a little scared.

scenes.caption: Lunch.
scenes.say: After that, we ate lunch on the grass.

scenes.caption: The shop.
scenes.say: Later, I bought a small toy elephant.

scenes.caption: Finally.
scenes.say: Finally, we went home. I was tired but happy.

scenes.caption: The end.
scenes.say: My recount tells what happened, in order.
